thought.text: Sekarang kirim token itu ke endpoint verifikasi Google — di situ skornya kelihatan.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && TOK=$(cat /tmp/demo_tok.txt); curl -s --max-time 30 \"https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v3-verify.php?action=homepage&token=$TOK\" -w \"\\nHTTP %{http_code}\\n\" | head -c 500", "summary": "Verify token score with Google demo verifier", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 60}

summary: Verify token score with Google demo verifier
